tools.name: gate_probe
tools.description:
The gate before your agent answers. Call this FIRST for any question, before spending effort: one cheap look returns a routing verdict in a few seconds.

- QUICK_LOOKUP: one page names the answer, with a quote copied from that page. Check the quote, then answer.
- NEEDS_FULL_JOB: worth a full search

tools.name: resolve_fragment
tools.description: Returns a verdict first, so your agent knows whether to answer, keep looking or say it can't place it: ORIGIN_OF_TRUTH (found, evidence checked, with sources), PARTIAL_ORIGIN (leads to follow, not an answer) or NOT_REACHABLE (SF's search reached nothing; not a claim the thing can't be found). Pieces

tools.name: submit_resolution_feedback
tools.description: After the user reacts to a resolve_fragment result, call this with its resolution_id. accepted: it is what they meant. partial: it helped but is not quite it. rejected: it is not what they meant. If they recognised an item in the shortlist or leads, send picked_rank (1 = first item) or picked_url; i
